{{Quote|Oh, he's yours. That explains the ambience suit.|Sharr Latt to Bhindi Drayson|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> }}
'''Ambience suits''' were full-body garments made of [[Color/Legends|black]] elastic cloth that used temperature sensors and thousands of fluid-filled capillaries to regulate their surface temperature, allowing the wearer to blend with the surrounding environment and remain nearly invisible to infrared [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]]. The suits consisted of a body stocking, gloves, shoes, and a hood that exposed only the wearer's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="MK" />
